rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when describing something as relating to numbers, usually before another noun.

example.english: This report has so much numerical data that it makes my head spin.
example.traditional: 呢份報告有好多數字資料，睇到我頭都大。
example.jyutping: ni1 fan6 bou3 gou3 jau5 hou2 do1 sou3 zi6 zi1 liu2 tai2 dou2 ngo5 tau4 dou1 daai6

rows.note: Use this for the technical or mathematical sense relating specifically to numerical values or data.

example.english: You have to enter the numerical values of this equation into a computer to calculate it.
example.traditional: 呢條方程式嘅數值要代入電腦先計到。
example.jyutping: ne1 tiu4 fong1 cing4 sik1 ge3 sou3 zik6 jiu3 doi6 jap6 din6 nou5 sin1 gai3 dou3
